description.value: Samz Neighbourhood Pub is a full-service neighbourhood pub and adjacent liquor store with locations in Port Coquitlam and Surrey, positioning itself as a go-to spot for casual dining, drinks, and watching live sports in the Lower Mainland. The Port Coquitlam location on Elgin Avenue offers dine-in service alongside a separately operated liquor store. Touring cyclists passing through PoCo could use it as a meal stop, with takeout also available via Skip the Dishes.

address.value: 2342 Elgin Avenue, Port Coquitlam, BC V3C 2B5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Port Coquitlam location at 2342 Elgin Avenue with pub phone 604-461-1174, matching OSM tags. Skip the Dishes ordering links on the homepage confirm takeout availability. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website, so all required criteria remain null; the menu is only available as a PDF download so dietary options are also unconfirmable.
concerns: Website menu is only available as a PDF download; dietary options (vegetarian, vegan, GF) are unverifiable.
No cycling amenities mentioned anywhere on the website.
Website page title references 'Surrey | Langley, Port Coquitlam' — minor branding inconsistency, but both locations are confirmed operational.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate operating pub and food destination, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from the website or OSM tags. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify cyclist-friendly basics before listing.
